decisions.statement: Every composed body reaches the checkout through the tracking landing.
Every body one call composes lands in one commit or lands in no commit.
No body reaches the landing through a scratch file.
A key on its way into akasha is written in camel here rather than by a caller.
A day that has not been written is not a day that is empty.
A patch is composed from the page there merged with the values the caller gave.
No row beside a day page is landed here.

definition: how a day page is landed into the akasha page store
